scripts.k8s:up: kubectl kustomize --load-restrictor LoadRestrictionsNone k8s | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl -n study rollout status statefulset/redis --timeout=120s && kubectl -n study rollout status deploy/web --timeout=180s
scripts.k8s:down: kubectl kustomize --load-restrictor LoadRestrictionsNone k8s | kubectl delete --ignore-not-found -f -
scripts.pg:cli: docker compose exec postgres psql -U study -d study
scripts.obs:up: docker compose --profile observability up -d prometheus alertmanager redis-exporter loki alloy tempo grafana
scripts.obs:down: docker compose --profile observability stop prometheus alertmanager redis-exporter loki alloy tempo grafana
scripts.k8s:metrics: kubectl apply -f k8s/addons/metrics-server.yaml && kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/metrics-server --timeout=120s
scripts.k8s:monitoring: helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts; helm repo update; helm upgrade --install kps prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n monitoring --create-namespace -f k8s/monitoring/values.yaml --wait --timeout 15m && kubectl apply -f k8s/monitoring/redis-servicemonitor.yaml
scripts.k8s:monitoring:down: kubectl delete -f k8s/monitoring/redis-servicemonitor.yaml --ignore-not-found; helm uninstall kps -n monitoring
scripts.k8s:minikube: minikube start --profile study --driver=docker --cpus 2 --memory 3072 && minikube addons enable metrics-server --profile study && minikube addons enable ingress --profile study
scripts.k8s:argocd: kubectl create namespace argocd --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml && kubectl apply -f k8s/argocd/argocd-cm-patch.yaml && kubectl -n argocd rollout status deploy/argocd-server --timeout=600s && kubectl apply -f k8s/argocd/application.yaml
scripts.k8s:argocd:password: kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d; echo
scripts.k8s:rollouts: kubectl create namespace argo-rollouts --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl apply --server-side -n argo-rollouts -f https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/releases/latest/download/install.yaml && kubectl -n argo-rollouts rollout status deploy/argo-rollouts --timeout=300s && kubectl apply -f k8s/rollouts/web-rollout.yaml
scripts.k8s:rollouts:watch: kubectl argo rollouts get rollout web-canary -n study --watch
scripts.cdc:up: docker compose --profile kafka --profile postgres --profile cdc up -d kafka postgres connect
scripts.nginx:tls: bash nginx/tls/gen-certs.sh && docker compose --profile nginx-tls up -d nginx-tls
scripts.k8s:netpol: kind create cluster --config k8s/security/kind-netpol.yaml && kubectl --context kind-study-netpol apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/projectcalico/calico/v3.29.1/manifests/calico.yaml && kubectl --context kind-study-netpol -n kube-system rollout status ds/calico-node --timeout=300s
scripts.k8s:falco: helm repo add falcosecurity https://falcosecurity.github.io/charts && helm upgrade --install falco falcosecurity/falco -n falco --create-namespace --set driver.kind=modern_ebpf --set tty=true --set falco.json_output=true --set falco.json_include_output_property=true --set falcosidekick.enabled=true --set collectors.kubernetes.enabled=false --wait --timeout 420s
scripts.mq:up: docker compose --profile mq up -d rabbitmq nats
scripts.mq:down: docker compose --profile mq stop rabbitmq nats
